$comment: +++===+++ 2026-10-15 — Hasan Alizada — HAAL-169. Which local days of the viewer an event occupies (FR-ACC-11, FR-CAL-01). All-day events are date-only and keep their dates in every zone; timed events are placed by their UTC instants (time.local_to_utc.v1) seen from the viewer's zone, so an event at 23:00 in Berlin lands on the next day for a viewer in Baku. Used by day, week and month views and for shared calendars across zones.
purpose: Returns the first and last local date (inclusive) that an event covers for a viewer in a given time zone.

end_time.description: Required when all_day is false; end ≥ start.

tzid.description: Zone the event's wall-clock times belong to.

viewer_tzid.description: Zone of the person looking at the calendar.

errors.when: tzid or viewer_tzid is not an IANA zone

invariants: all-day: first_day = start_date and last_day = end_date, whatever the zones
timed: first_day is the viewer-local date of the start instant; last_day is the viewer-local date of the end instant
timed: an end exactly at viewer-local midnight does not occupy that day (22:00–00:00 is one day), unless the event has zero length
